why: 1) QUOTE: exists verbatim, but only inside one troubleshooting-table cell (llm-gateway-connect.md line 500), and the whole line reframes it. The row's trigger is a gateway enforcing a smaller CONTEXT WINDOW ('400 errors stating a context or token limit ... ContextWindowExceededError or prompt token count of N exceeds the limit of M'); the remediation is '/compact' plus CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, and 'Also set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS below the gateway model's output limit' is the trailing clause of that same cell. The claimed BEHAVIOUR ('when a gateway enforces an output limit below the model's, the remediation is a client-side output cap') detaches the tail clause from the row it belongs to. 2) EVIDENCE: wrong subsystem, and one wrong line. packages/core/src/types/message.ts:464 is 'export type CostReporting = ...'; the comment is at :477, and both it and packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/event-adapter.ts:94 are the PERSISTED USAGE TELEMETRY projection (ModelUsage -> PersistedModelUsage), explaining why the SDK's REPORTED maxOutputTokens capacity figure is not summed across turns. That is accounting, not a request parameter; the two hits neither support nor bear on an output cap. Sibling-subsystem confusion of exactly the shape AGENTS.md warns about. 3) CONSEQUENCE ('there is no way to cap requested output tokens'): false one layer up, on the very backend the doc page governs. packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:236-264 buildClaudeSubprocessEnv builds the Claude runtime's env as {...process.env, ...proxy, ...overrides} and deletes exactly three vars (CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL); pi-agent.ts:1465 likewise spreads ...process.env. CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS therefore reaches the bundled Claude runtime unstripped, and that runtime implements it: positive control, `strings node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude` contains 'output token maximum. To configure this behavior, set the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS environment variable.' (5 further occurrences of the bare name). The documented remediation works today on the Claude backend with no fork-side code at all. 4) 'No equivalent under any spelling' is a sweep artifact: only MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS/maxOutputTokens were grepped. This repo's spelling for a requested output cap is maxTokens - claude-agent.ts:3150 forwards request.maxTokens into the SDK query, codex-agent.ts:580 sends `max_tokens: request.maxTokens ?? 4096`, llm-tool.ts:587 exposes maxTokens (1..64000) to the model, and packages/pi-agent-server/src/custom-endpoint-models.ts:67 hard-caps `maxTokens: 8_192` on every custom/gateway endpoint model definition (buildCustomEndpointModelDef, called from pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1181). So a client-side output cap below the gateway model's limit demonstrably exists on the gateway path; it is fixed at 8k rather than absent. 5) The sibling half of the SAME doc cell is implemented under the fork's rename convention: packages/shared/src/config/auto-compaction-settings.ts:34-45 resolves NESSY_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, NESSY_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE and DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT (mirror mandated by docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-27-compaction-parity.md:82). The fork does mirror this knob family under NESSY_ prefixes; the output-token member is the one not yet mirrored. Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (checked; none concerns token budgets).
correctedState: Narrow, tunability-only gap - not the absence claimed. On the Claude backend the documented remediation already works unchanged: buildClaudeSubprocessEnv (packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:236-264) passes the ambient environment to the Claude runtime verbatim apart from three Bedrock vars, and the bundled runtime binary reads CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS itself (confirmed by strings on node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude). On the Pi/Nessy-Gateway path a client-side output cap does exist but is hardcoded: buildCustomEndpointModelDef sets maxTokens: 8_192 for every custom-endpoint model (packages/pi-agent-server/src/custom-endpoint-models.ts:67), and per-request maxTokens is plumbed at claude-agent.ts:3150, codex-agent.ts:580 and llm-tool.ts:587. What is genuinely missing is a user-tunable equivalent on the Pi path - a NESSY_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS alongside the already-implemented NESSY_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW / NESSY_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE / DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT (packages/shared/src/config/auto-compaction-settings.ts:34-45). The cited evidence (message.ts:464/:477, claude/event-adapter.ts:94) is unrelated: it is the persisted usage-telemetry projection dropping a reported capacity figure, not a request parameter.
